articles.title: Principal Allegedly Brings Knife and Cleaver to Campus, FIR and Suspension Action Initiated
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A government primary school in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district sparked controversy after its principal allegedly arrived on campus carrying a knife and a cleaver, triggering panic among students, teachers and parents.

body.html:
A government primary school in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district sparked controversy after its principal allegedly arrived on campus carrying a knife and a cleaver, triggering panic among students, teachers and parents.

The incident involved government school principal Shikha Singh and prompted immediate intervention by the police and the education department. Authorities have seized the sharp weapons, initiated legal proceedings and begun the process to suspend the principal.

Videos and photographs allegedly showing the principal carrying the weapons went viral on social media, raising concerns over safety in educational institutions.

According to reports, Singh admitted to bringing the knife and cleaver to school but claimed she did so because she felt threatened. However, she reportedly did not identify any individual or explain the nature of the alleged threat.

After local residents alerted authorities, a police team, accompanied by Block Education Officer (BEO) Neeraj Umrao, reached the school. Officials recovered the weapons from the premises and recorded statements from teachers and staff as part of the investigation.

District Basic Education Officer (BSA) Kamlendra Kushwaha said the department acted immediately after the incident came to light. An FIR is being registered against the principal, and departmental proceedings for her suspension have been initiated.

Officials also said a parent informed the BEO that the principal had allegedly shown the sharp weapons to some parents before entering the school. During the inquiry, authorities also spoke to the principal's family members.

According to officials, Shikha Singh's husband informed investigators that she may be dealing with mental health-related issues. Authorities have not confirmed whether this had any role in the incident and said all aspects of the case are being examined.

Police have taken the recovered weapons into custody, while the education department continues its detailed inquiry. Officials said further action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

#UttarPradesh #Kaushambi #SchoolSafety #GovernmentSchool

articles.title: 5-Year-Old Allegedly Beaten for 8 Minutes by Class Monitor as Teacher Was Away
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A five-year-old nursery student was allegedly assaulted by his class monitor for nearly eight minutes inside a classroom at a private school in Lucknow, leaving him with severe bruises on his face. The incident, which took place at ALS Academy on Wednesday, was captured on CCTV.

body.html:
A five-year-old nursery student was allegedly assaulted by his class monitor for nearly eight minutes inside a classroom at a private school in Lucknow, leaving him with severe bruises on his face. The incident, which took place at ALS Academy on Wednesday, was captured on CCTV.

According to the footage, a teacher was present in the classroom with around 18 students before asking them to keep their heads down on their desks. The teacher then allegedly instructed the class monitor to keep an eye on the class and left the room.

Soon after the teacher left, the monitor was seen allegedly hitting students who raised their heads. She then allegedly targeted the five-year-old boy, slapping him multiple times and repeatedly forcing his head down onto the desk.

When the child began crying and tried to keep his head up, the monitor allegedly continued slapping him. A short while later, the boy attempted to run towards the classroom door but was allegedly stopped, dragged back inside and slapped again. The monitor then allegedly bolted the classroom door from the inside.

The CCTV footage reportedly shows the child trying to open another door before being dragged back to his seat, where the assault allegedly continued. Throughout the incident, the other students remained seated with their heads down.

The teacher returned about 10 minutes later and knocked on the classroom door. After the monitor opened it, the boy immediately complained to the teacher, who was seen speaking to both students.

The incident came to light after the child returned home with a swollen face and bruises. His parents then visited the school, where they reviewed the CCTV footage.

Following the incident, the school expelled the class monitor.

#Lucknow #UttarPradesh #School #Student #ChildSafety #Education

articles.title: Temple Trip Turns Deadly: Andhra Woman, Lover Arrested for Allegedly Plotting Husband's Murder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 19-year-old woman and her alleged lover have been arrested for allegedly conspiring to murder her husband during a temple visit in Andhra Pradesh's Chittoor district, police said. The victim, Ramesh (23), a native of Tamil Nadu, worked for a private firm in Hosur.

body.html:
A 19-year-old woman and her alleged lover have been arrested for allegedly conspiring to murder her husband during a temple visit in Andhra Pradesh's Chittoor district, police said.

The victim, Ramesh (23), a native of Tamil Nadu, worked for a private firm in Hosur. He had been married to Hasini for two years, and the couple had a toddler daughter.

According to the police investigation, Hasini allegedly maintained a relationship with her childhood friend, Yugandhar (20), and the two conspired to kill Ramesh.

Police said Hasini persuaded her husband to take her and their daughter to the Sri Malleshwara Swamy Temple atop Mallappa Konda hills. During the journey, she allegedly shared the family's live location with Yugandhar through her mobile phone, enabling him and his associates to track their movements.

Investigators alleged that near the third hairpin bend on the hill road, Hasini threw her handbag onto the road, prompting Ramesh to stop his motorcycle. At that point, Yugandhar and his accomplices allegedly attacked him.

Police said Ramesh tried to escape into the nearby forest but was chased and hacked to death with sharp weapons. The attack allegedly took place while the couple's young daughter was nearby.

The case came to light after Hasini's mother approached the police when the family failed to return home. During the investigation, CCTV footage reportedly showed Ramesh travelling towards the temple with his family, while later footage allegedly captured Hasini riding away on his motorcycle with two other men.

Using CCTV footage, mobile phone records and GPS location data, police traced Ramesh's body in the forest. Hasini, Yugandhar and two alleged accomplices were subsequently arrested.

Police are also verifying claims by local villagers that Hasini was a minor when she married Ramesh two years ago. If confirmed, separate legal proceedings relating to alleged child marriage violations may also follow.

#AndhraPradesh #Chittoor #CrimeNews #MurderCase #TempleVisit

articles.title: Bengaluru Horror: Law Student Dies Days After Daylight Stabbing Over Rejected Marriage Proposal
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 22-year-old law student, who was allegedly stabbed in broad daylight in Bengaluru by the younger brother of a man whose marriage proposal she had rejected, succumbed to her injuries at a private hospital on Wednesday after battling for her life for three days.

body.html:
A 22-year-old law student, who was allegedly stabbed in broad daylight in Bengaluru by the younger brother of a man whose marriage proposal she had rejected, succumbed to her injuries at a private hospital on Wednesday after battling for her life for three days.

The victim, identified as Amrutha, was a resident of Kodihalli. Police have arrested the two accused, Surya and his elder brother Dhanush, both residents of Kodihalli.

According to police, the attack took place near HAL on July 13 while Amrutha was returning home. Surya allegedly followed her for some distance before stabbing her multiple times with a knife and attempting to flee.

The investigation revealed that the attack was allegedly linked to Amrutha's refusal to marry Dhanush after she learnt that he had allegedly concealed the fact that he was divorced and had a child. Police said Dhanush had been pressuring her to accept the proposal, while Surya had allegedly threatened her over the rejection.

Amrutha was rushed to a nearby private hospital following the attack but succumbed to her injuries on Wednesday.

The incident sparked public outrage as the assault occurred on a busy road in broad daylight. Passersby chased Surya, caught him at the scene and allegedly assaulted him before handing him over to the police.

The Jeevan Bima Nagar police have registered a case and are continuing their investigation.

#Bengaluru #Karnataka #CrimeNews #LawStudent #BreakingNews

articles.title: GST Deputy Commissioner Caught Allegedly Taking ₹50,000 Bribe in Varanasi Vigilance Trap
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Uttar Pradesh Vigilance Establishment's Varanasi Sector Anti-Corruption Team has arrested a woman Deputy Commissioner of GST (State) after allegedly catching her red-handed while accepting a ₹50,000 bribe from a businessman in Varanasi.

body.html:
The Uttar Pradesh Vigilance Establishment's Varanasi Sector Anti-Corruption Team has arrested a woman Deputy Commissioner of GST (State) after allegedly catching her red-handed while accepting a ₹50,000 bribe from a businessman in Varanasi.

The accused, identified as Ambika, was posted as Deputy Commissioner, GST (State), Sector 6. According to vigilance officials, she had allegedly demanded the bribe to clear the complainant's pending company returns and GST assessment.

The complainant, Ajay Kumar Maurya, a resident of Bajardiha in Varanasi and director of Black Smith Industries Pvt. Ltd., filed a written complaint with the Superintendent of Police, Vigilance Establishment. He alleged that the officer demanded ₹50,000 to resolve issues related to his company's February 2023 GST returns and assessment.

Acting on the complaint, the Vigilance team laid a trap near Dada Restaurant in the Chetganj area. As part of the operation, the businessman met the officer with the marked currency notes.

According to officials, the team immediately moved in after Ambika allegedly accepted the ₹50,000 bribe and recovered the entire amount from her possession. During the operation, she allegedly resisted while being taken into custody by women police personnel in plain clothes.

Following the arrest, the Vigilance Establishment registered a case against the accused under the relevant provisions of the Prevention of Corruption Act.

Officials said further investigation is underway and additional legal action will be taken based on the evidence collected during the trap operation.

#Varanasi #UttarPradesh #GST #Corruption #Bribery

articles.title: Suspended UP Cop's Alleged Drunken Highway Rampage Ends in Mob Chase, Arrest
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A suspended Uttar Pradesh police constable was allegedly caught after a late-night drunken driving rampage on the Delhi-Lucknow Highway in Amroha, during which two pedestrians were injured before angry motorists and locals intercepted and assaulted him.

body.html:
A suspended Uttar Pradesh police constable was allegedly caught after a late-night drunken driving rampage on the Delhi-Lucknow Highway in Amroha, during which two pedestrians were injured before angry motorists and locals intercepted and assaulted him.

The accused, identified as Sanjeev Tomar, was allegedly driving under the influence of alcohol around 11 pm on Monday when he hit two pedestrians near Joya, police said.

According to officials, instead of stopping to help, Tomar allegedly continued speeding along the highway. Eyewitnesses claimed he kept driving even after one of the car's tyres came off, with the vehicle travelling on its bare rim for some distance, creating a dangerous situation and sending sparks flying.

The chase ended near Didauli, where motorists and local residents intercepted the vehicle. Enraged by the incident, they allegedly pulled Tomar out of the car and assaulted him before police arrived and rescued him from the crowd.

The two injured victims were shifted to a private hospital, where they are undergoing treatment.

Police have registered a case against Tomar under Sections 109(1) (attempt to murder), 323 (voluntarily causing hurt) and 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

Amroha Additional Superintendent of Police Akhilesh Bhadauria said the case was registered based on a complaint filed by the victims and that the investigation is underway.

Police officials said Tomar, who was attached to the Dial 112 emergency response unit, had already been suspended over alleged dereliction of duty before the latest incident. He is now expected to face stricter departmental action in addition to the fresh criminal charges.

#Amroha #UttarPradesh #DrunkDriving #Police #RoadRage

articles.title: Two UP Government School Teachers Suspended After Classroom Footage Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two teachers posted at a government composite school in Uttar Pradesh's Kannauj district have been suspended after videos allegedly showing them behaving inappropriately inside a classroom surfaced on social media, triggering outrage and prompting disciplinary action.

body.html:
Two teachers posted at a government composite school in Uttar Pradesh's Kannauj district have been suspended after videos allegedly showing them behaving inappropriately inside a classroom surfaced on social media, triggering outrage and prompting disciplinary action.

The suspended staff members, an assistant teacher and a female assistant teacher, were posted at the government composite school in Bajedi village under the Saurikh block.

According to reports, the videos are believed to have been recorded during the winter months, based on the clothing seen in the footage. The male teacher's wife allegedly became suspicious of his relationship with his colleague and reportedly installed a hidden camera inside the classroom to gather evidence.

The device allegedly captured videos showing the two teachers in objectionable circumstances during school hours. The recordings later went viral, drawing criticism from parents, local residents and education officials.

The school caters to students from primary and upper primary classes. Following the circulation of the videos, parents and villagers expressed concern over discipline and professional conduct in educational institutions. Some relatives of the teachers also reached the school and created a commotion, though both teachers were absent at the time.

The matter was officially taken up on July 13, when District Basic Education Officer (BSA) Sandeep Kumar directed Saurikh Block Education Officer (BEO) Vishwanath Pathak to investigate the allegations.

After reviewing the inquiry findings, the BSA suspended both teachers. During the suspension period, the assistant teacher has been attached to the Gugarapur Block Resource Centre (BRC), while the female assistant teacher has been attached to the Talgram BRC.

Education officials have also sought detailed reports from the concerned officers within 15 days as the inquiry continues.

#UttarPradesh #Kannauj #GovernmentSchool #Teachers

articles.title: Young Woman Hacked to Death at Crowded KSRTC Bus Stand, Attacker Flees
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young woman was allegedly hacked to death in broad daylight at the KSRTC bus stand in Karnataka's Bantwal on Thursday, triggering panic among commuters and prompting police to launch a massive manhunt for the absconding accused.

body.html:
A young woman was allegedly hacked to death in broad daylight at the KSRTC bus stand in Karnataka's Bantwal on Thursday, triggering panic among commuters and prompting police to launch a massive manhunt for the absconding accused.

The victim, identified as Lavanya, was a resident of Kakkepadavu and worked at a private nursing home in Kalladka.

According to preliminary information, Lavanya had boarded a KSRTC bus bound for Kakkepadavu from Bantwal. Before the incident, she reportedly called a relative and informed them that a young man was sitting next to her inside the bus. The call was allegedly disconnected shortly afterwards. Police are verifying the details of the conversation.

Based on preliminary statements from passengers, both Lavanya and the suspected attacker got off the bus at the Bantwal KSRTC bus stand. Witnesses told police that the man allegedly chased her after they alighted. When he reportedly pulled out a sharp weapon from his bag, Lavanya attempted to flee but was caught and repeatedly attacked, sustaining fatal injuries before the accused escaped.

The attack, which unfolded in front of commuters and bystanders, created panic at the busy bus stand, with frightened passengers rushing away from the scene. Local residents alerted the police and emergency services.

Police rushed to the spot, secured the crime scene and registered a murder case. Senior officers from the Bantwal Sub-Division Police and other officials inspected the scene.

Investigators are examining CCTV footage from the bus stand and nearby establishments, recording statements of passengers and eyewitnesses, and analysing the victim's mobile phone records. Police have not yet disclosed the identity of the accused or confirmed whether he was known to the victim.

Officials said all possible angles, including a prior acquaintance between the victim and the accused, are being investigated. The motive behind the murder remains unclear.

Police have appealed to the public to share any information that could help trace the accused, who remains at large.

#Karnataka #Bantwal #Murder #CrimeNews #KSRTC

articles.title: Woman Allegedly Runs Over Domestic Worker, Returns Body to Accident Spot
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 57-year-old domestic worker was allegedly run over by a woman driving a Thar in Gurugram, who then took the injured victim to a hospital and, after she was declared dead, allegedly brought the body back and placed it at the accident spot before informing anyone.

body.html:
A 57-year-old domestic worker was allegedly run over by a woman driving a Thar in Gurugram, who then took the injured victim to a hospital and, after she was declared dead, allegedly brought the body back and placed it at the accident spot before informing anyone.

The incident took place at Ansal Versalia Society in Sector 67, Gurugram. The victim, identified as Guddi, was a native of Mahoba in Uttar Pradesh.

According to police, Guddi had finished work at a house in the society and was sleeping in the ground-floor parking area when a woman resident allegedly ran over her while reversing her Thar.

Police said the driver took the injured woman to a private hospital in another vehicle, where doctors declared her dead. The driver then allegedly returned to the society and placed the body at the exact spot where the accident had occurred.

After receiving information, Sector 65 police reached the scene, took custody of the body and sent it for post-mortem examination.

Guddi's nephew alleged that the driver neither informed the family nor residents about her death and instead left the body in the parking area.

The incident triggered protests outside the driver's residence, with local residents demanding action.

Police are questioning the driver and examining CCTV footage from the society to establish the sequence of events.

A senior police officer said further action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

#Gurugram #Haryana #RoadAccident #DomesticWorker

articles.title: Hyderabad School Under Fire After Hindu Class 2 Student Allegedly Given Islamic Prayers as Homework
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversy has erupted at a private school in Hyderabad after the family of a six-year-old Hindu student alleged that he was instructed to recite Islamic prayers as part of his homework, prompting demands for action against the school management.

body.html:
A controversy has erupted at a private school in Hyderabad after the family of a six-year-old Hindu student alleged that he was instructed to recite Islamic prayers as part of his homework, prompting demands for action against the school management.

The incident allegedly took place at Success School in Hyderabad's Saidabad area. According to the family, the Class 2 student's homework diary contained instructions to "Read Kalma 1 and 2" and "Read Fatiha," the opening chapter of the Quran. The family said they approached the school after noticing the entries.

A relative of the child said she was shocked to find the instructions in the homework diary and questioned why religious recitations were being assigned to a six-year-old student. She also claimed a similar entry had appeared earlier in the diary but had later been struck off, which the family initially ignored.

According to the relative, when she confronted the school principal, she was initially told that the recitation was a religious practice and mandatory for all students. She alleged that the explanation later changed, with the teacher claiming it was a mistake.

The family further claimed that another similar entry, which had been struck off earlier, was found while reviewing the diary. They expressed concern that other students might also have received similar assignments.

The child's relative demanded an official inquiry, urging the Education Department to investigate the school's practices. She said that if the lessons were part of an optional subject, only students who had opted for it should receive such assignments separately. She also alleged that assigning religious recitations to children from other faiths was unacceptable and called for action by the authorities.

#Hyderabad #Telangana #SuccessSchool #Education
